response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_avg_bandwidth, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count FROM (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) g
